_meta.description: Per-node vulnerability derived from an UNBIASED pull of CVEs for a representative real-world product of each node's component type, instead of hand-picked CVEs. For each node, every CVE published in the last 5 years against the product's NVD CPE (or, where no clean CPE exists, an NVD keyword search) was retrieved via the NVD CVE API, restricted to entries that carry a CVSS v3.x score. No CVE was hand-picked for this version.
_meta.formula: derived_vulnerability = median(exploitability_score over all matching CVEs) / 3.9, clipped to [0.05, 0.95] ONLY if the raw value falls outside that range. 3.9 is the maximum possible CVSS v3.x exploitability subscore (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N).
_meta.method: NVD CVE API 2.0 (https://services.nvd.nist.gov/rest/json/cves/2.0), queried by virtualMatchString (CPE) or keywordSearch per node, all pages fetched, deduplicated by CVE ID, then filtered to published >= cutoff_date and having at least one cvssMetricV31/V30 entry. The 'Primary'-typed CVSS v3.x entry was used where present, otherwise the first available v3.x entry.
_meta.raw_data: Full unfiltered API responses per node are saved under data/raw/<node>.json; the exact set of CVE IDs kept after filtering, per node, is in data/raw/_summary.json.

data_quality_flags.historian_server: Only n=2 CVEs matched after filtering (osisoft:pi_server, aveva:pi_server and osisoft:pi_data_archive CPEs together returned just 15 CVEs total over all time, 2 within the last 5 years). This median is NOT trustworthy as a population estimate - treat it as anecdotal. It also happens to land exactly at the 0.95 cap.
data_quality_flags.scada_server: n=9 after filtering. Small sample; treat with moderate caution.
data_quality_flags.intelligent_electronic_device: n=13 after filtering. Small sample; treat with moderate caution.
data_quality_flags.remote_terminal_unit: median_normalized genuinely reaches 1.0 (median exploitability_score = 3.9, the CVSS v3.x ceiling) and is clipped to 0.95. With n=21, this is a real population result, not an artifact of a single outlier CVE - more than half of the matched Modicon/Modbus CVEs in the last 5 years are unauthenticated, network-exploitable (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N).
data_quality_flags.engineering_workstation: Product family is generic Microsoft Windows 10 (the OS layer of a 'Windows-based engineering workstation'), which is a much broader and noisier population (n=664) than the ICS-vendor-specific products used for the other nodes - most of these CVEs have nothing to do with ICS/OT specifically. Treat this node's number as representative of 'a Windows 10 host' in general, not of engineering-workstation-specific risk.

physical_equipment.note: No CVE could be found for this node, in either the hand-picked or the unbiased pull. physical_equipment represents the end physical process asset (e.g. a circuit breaker or transformer) rather than networked software or firmware, so it has no CPE entry and no associated CVEs in NVD. Its vulnerability value is left hardcoded in src/graph.py instead of being derived from CVE data.
